dance.vibe: London's home for immersive theatre and alternative arts, deep under Waterloo station. Drinks before and after at its pub, Vaulty Towers.

dance.name: The Cross
dance.vibe: The ’90s King’s Cross club, back across six floors on Wharfdale Road with a rooftop terrace looking over the London skyline. DJs play the club on Fridays and Saturdays, 7pm to 3am, for guests 25 and over.

images.alt: A crowd dancing behind the DJ decks at The Cross, King's Cross

dance.name: Hootananny Brixton
dance.vibe: A striking Victorian building in Brixton with a big beer garden, a live music venue since 2007. Gigs and club nights run through jungle, disco, reggae, highlife, house and electronic.

dance.name: Bermondsey Social Club
dance.vibe: A railway arch on Almond Road with room for 120, plus a hidden courtyard garden where the train lines split. House, techno and drum and bass club nights and gigs on a 4am licence.

dance.name: Brixton Storeys
dance.vibe: Built on the old Prince of Wales site, a 750-capacity Brixton venue with a rare 24-hour licence. The 500-capacity club room has immersive lighting, and the two-tier rooftop has its own DJ booths and a retractable roof.
